description.zh: 报警联系人组。多个联系人组之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The alert contact group. Separate multiple contact groups with commas (,).

description.zh: 报警规则生效的时间范围。取值范围：00:00-23:59。
description.en: The time period during which the alert rule is effective. Valid values: 00:00-23:59.
The subject of the alert email.

description.zh: 自定义事件名称。获取方法请参见[DescribeCustomEventAttribute](~~115262~~)。
description.en: The name of the custom event. For information about how to obtain the name, see [DescribeCustomEventAttribute](~~115262~~).

description.zh:
应用分组ID。获取方法请参见[DescribeCustomEventAttribute](~~115262~~)。

> 0表示上报的自定义事件不属于任何一个应用分组。
description.en:
The ID of the application group. For information about how to obtain the ID, see [DescribeCustomEventAttribute](~~115262~~).

> A value of 0 indicates that the reported custom event does not belong to any application group.

description.zh:
报警级别。取值：
- CRITICAL：严重。
- WARN：警告。
- INFO：信息。
description.en:
The alert level. Valid values:
- CRITICAL
- WARN
- INFO

description.zh: 自定义事件监控数据的聚合周期。单位：秒。取值为60或60的整数倍。默认值：300。
description.en: The aggregation period of the monitoring data for the custom event. Unit: seconds. The value must be 60 or a multiple of 60. Default value: 300.

description.zh:
报警规则ID。

> 如果报警规则ID已存在，则表示修改报警规则；如果报警规则ID不存在，则表示创建报警规则。
description.en:
The ID of the alert rule.

> If the alert rule ID already exists, the alert rule is modified. If the alert rule ID does not exist, an alert rule is created.
The name of the alert rule.

description.zh: 报警发生回调时指定的URL地址，向URL发送POST请求。
description.en: The callback URL to which a POST request is sent when an alert is triggered.

title.zh: 创建自定义事件报警规则
title.en: Create an alert rule for a custom event

descriptions.zh: 调用本接口前，请先调用PutCustomEvent接口上报自定义事件的监控数据，详情请参见[PutCustomEvent](~~115012~~)。
descriptions.en: Before you call this operation, you must call the PutCustomEvent operation to report the monitoring data of the custom event. For more information, see [PutCustomEvent](~~115012~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms put-custom-event-rule --group-id 73780000 --rule-id CustomRuleId1 --rule-name CustomeRule --event-name HostDown --contact-groups ECS_Group --webhook https://www.aliyun.com --effective-interval 00:00-23:59 --period 60 --email-subject ECS_instance --threshold 99 --level CRITICAL --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms PutCustomEventRule --region cn-hangzhou --ContactGroups ECS_Group --RuleId CustomRuleId1 --EmailSubject ECS_instance --Period 60 --Webhook 'https://www.aliyun.com' --Level CRITICAL --EventName HostDown --EffectiveInterval '00:00-23:59' --RuleName CustomeRule --GroupId 73780000 --Threshold 99
